original_cost_source: Mansfield, Schwartz & Wagner, Economic Journal 91(364):907-918 (1981), doi:10.2307/2232499
what_the_ratio_includes: full imitation cost / full innovation cost
caveats: the pre-machine-intelligence anchor: imitation cost ~65% of innovation cost, imitation time ~70%, 60% of patented innovations imitated within 4 years, patents raised imitation cost only ~7% (Levin et al. 1987: 7-15%)
